text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building and redesigning websites with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

I’d be a strong fit for your website redesign because I focus on creating clean, responsive, conversion-friendly sites that are easy for visitors to use and easy for your team to maintain. For a local cleaning business, that means a site that clearly presents your services, builds trust quickly, and performs well on mobile and desktop alike. I also pay close attention to speed, structure, and SEO best practices so the redesign supports visibility as well as usability.

One relevant project was a home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home. I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS that the marketing team could edit themselves. The result was a reduction in largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s, along with 38% organic traffic growth in 3 months. That experience is directly relevant to improving performance, responsiveness, and search visibility for your current site.

For your project, I can help with:
- a complete visual redesign aligned with your brand identity
- responsive layout improvements for all devices
- clearer service presentation and stronger calls to action
- performance optimization for faster load times
- SEO-friendly structure and content organization
- integration of any needed tools or plugins

I’m comfortable collaborating closely, asking the right questions early, and turning feedback into a polished final result. If you’d like, I can also help assess the current site structure and recommend the best approach for the redesign before work begins.

If you’re looking for someone who can combine design sensibility with practical development and a strong focus on user experience, I’d love to help revamp your website.
